$comment: Lanes of the stability lab (plans/cmux-next/chrome-parity/p10-stability.md 3A; runner stability-lab.py). The runner fills {app}, {previous_app}, {job}, {out} and {host}, writes the step's combined stdout and stderr to the lane's stdout path, puts the run's crash reports and panic logs in {out}/crashes, and gives the run to `stability-lab.py signatures`. `stability-lab.py lanes --check` validates this file.

lab-mini-fast.note: The update, skew and restore lanes run one after another on one lab mini per tip (about 30 min). They are preemptible: a foreground step on that mini stops them, and the next tick runs them again.
